New nodes must verifiably compute deterministic token generation puzzles—such as producing a metric-constrained sonnet within tight latency windows—forcing the attacker into a resource spiral of dedicated GPU cycles and power per persona. However, this approach inherently penalizes low-compute honest agents while letting well-funded cartels buy disproportionate influence.
